title: Closed-session testimony on Rocky Flats

tellings.quote: I've been back several times in u restricted sessions. >> Okay. >> On security issues with the energy department on especially on Rocky Flats, Colorado.

plain: John S. Herrington, a former US Secretary of Energy, says he has gone back to Congress several times to testify in closed, restricted sessions. He tells Michels the sessions were about security issues at the Energy Department, especially at Rocky Flats, Colorado, a government site run under that department. He does not give dates, and he raises it as part of his own history with secret government matters.
